reason: The cited evidence shows active learning DNNs can be trained on liquid and crystalline states (E4, E5) and that active learning tailors potentials to specific configurational spaces (E2), but no evidence supports the claimed 50% TI error reduction, improved phase-space overlap for liquids, or specific applicability to equimolar refractory HEAs near melting.
premises: On-the-fly DNN training with active learning can sample rare liquid configurations
Such a DNN potential improves phase-space overlap with ab initio ensembles
Improved overlap reduces thermodynamic integration (TI) path mismatch
The reduction in TI error is ~50% relative to EAM references
The approach is applicable to equimolar refractory HEAs near melting
